Maya: starting bringup for orchestra-embed-v1 (fp16 -> int8-per-channel). quick smoke shows a weird bump in nearest-neighbour distance for very short queries. dropping summary below.
EmbedBot: job-12011 finished: orchestra-embed-v1 | dataset=short-sample-8k | quant=int8-per-channel | status=complete
Maya: TL;DR stats (8k queries)
```
Recall@1: 0.593 (fp16 0.608, delta -0.015)
Recall@5: 0.812 (fp16 0.856, delta -0.044)
Recall@10: 0.895 (fp16 0.902, delta -0.007)
Top1 cosine mean: 0.71 -> 0.62
Length-binned R@5 delta: len<=7: -0.078, 7<len<=18: -0.019, >18: -0.004
```
Ravi: that's a sizeable short-query drop. did you renormalize after quantization?
Maya: yes, vectors L2-normalized post-encode. tried both pre- and post-norm, similar outcome.
Bea: can you share the eval command?
Maya: `python -m eval.run --model orchestra-embed-v1 --quant int8 --calib 1024 --dataset short-sample --nprobe 10 --normalize`
QuantBot: quick check: per-tensor run queued (job-12012), hybrid final-fp16 run queued (job-12013).
Ravi: please also run 1k calibration with per-channel asymmetric scales. symmetric scaling sometimes underestimates tail values.
Maya: kicking asymmetric per-channel now.
Bea: also eyeball nearest-neighbor histogram. if median shifts down, ranking order will scramble.
Maya: uploaded nn-hist: median top1 cos fp16=0.79 int8=0.67. plot: /artifacts/orchestra/int8/nn-hist.png
Ravi: try disabling quant-aware folding for the final linear; sometimes bias folding accumulates rounding error.
Maya: queued a run disabling bias folding.
EmbedBot: flagged: significant regression concentrated on exact-match and paraphrase pairs for len<=7.
Bea: short-term mitigation: increase nprobe to 16 for short-query-heavy customers and enable client-side renorm at retrieval. both quick wins.
Maya: noted. adding ticket ENG-ML-2055 and attaching logs/plots.
Ravi: if hybrid run recovers >90% of delta, prefer hybrid for staging and update onboarding doc.
Maya: will post hybrid numbers when done. ETA ~25m.
EmbedBot: queued runs summary: per-tensor, asymmetric-per-channel, no-bias-fold, hybrid-final-fp16. runcount=4
